name: SkilzVolt
description: Owner-only, fixed-endpoint access to governed SkilzVolt workspace skills.

connectionKeyEnv.description: Legacy fallback: environment variable containing a static SkilzVolt bearer connection key, used only when no `openclaw skilzvolt login` OAuth session is connected.

allowProposals.description: Allow the three governed SkilzVolt proposal operations.

sharePointWriterEnabled.description: Enable the owner-only bounded SharePoint writer used by organisation skills. It never exposes shell commands or direct queue-file editing.

expenseSharePointEnabled.description: Explicitly enable the fixed owner-only expense SharePoint boundary after the Pi finance service, queue processor, and media permissions have been installed. Enabling SkilzVolt alone never enables this route.

agentIds.description: Agents that receive SkilzVolt organisation-knowledge guidance.

organisationSkillNames.description: Local managed skills eligible for verified migration retirement.
